Earlier scenes:

This scene:
这是古代的故事。孟子小的时候，他的爸爸很早就去世了。从他的家到墓地很近，所以他每天老是从早到晚去墓地跟朋友们玩玩儿。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 这是古代的故事：这是一个古代的故事
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 从他的家到墓地很近：他的家离墓地很近
- 所以他每天老是从早到晚去墓地跟朋友们玩玩儿：delete老是；玩儿，V.V. is used to make requests or plans

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 从他的家到墓地很近：孟子的家离墓地很近，use 离 to describe that two places are close; 从……到…… normally marks a route or range rather than proximity. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 从早到晚去墓地跟朋友们玩玩儿：从早到晚都在墓地跟朋友们玩儿，from-morning-to-evening duration should describe the sustained activity at the location; 玩玩儿 suggests a brief, casual activity and does not fit an all-day duration. [rule: none]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子小的时候：有一个小男孩叫孟子。孟子小的时候，this is the character’s first mention, so introduce his name and identity clearly before using him in the story. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 所以他每天：所以孟子每天，repeat the name because the previous sentence also mentions his father, so the pronoun can have two possible male referents. [rule: ambiguous_reference]

items.reason: 从……到……不用于表达两地相近，应用“离”。
“玩玩儿”的重叠形式不适合表示从早到晚持续进行的活动。
孟子第一次出现时应先明确介绍这个人物。
孟子刚在前文出现且父亲已去世，“他”在这里可以清楚地指孟子；所示改后文字也仍是不完整片段。
